note: No `contextId`: the VTA must be told which context the addressed DID belongs to, and checks the caller's standing there before reading the document (VTI-NTF-056).
An empty `document` carries nothing to verify; a deposit always carries the document the client received.
Unknown top-level member — a client stating its own view of the sender, such as whether it trusts it — is refused: the VTA's acceptance policy decides, on the document alone (VTI-NTF-055).
